title: Passenger Id does not exist
why: Checks that an unknown but well-formed Id gives a clean not-found result rather than an empty success or a crash.

steps.does: Call gRPC PassengerGrpcService/GetById with the well-formed Id 99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999, which matches no row.

expect: gRPC NOT_FOUND status and no passenger data.
